author: claude-code
question: what happens when the gateway drops the call

blocks.text: one_try is the single charge call; keeping it in a function lets the loop below treat "charge" as one thing that either returns or raises.
blocks.title: One attempt, as a function

blocks.text: This is the only line that talks to the gateway, so it is the only place a dropped connection can come from.
blocks.title: The call itself

blocks.text: Only a dropped connection is retried: any other error leaves the loop at once. When every attempt drops, the function raises ChargeError.
blocks.title: Try, and try again

stops.name: retry_charge
stops.text: retry_charge calls the gateway and tries again when the call drops, up to a fixed number of attempts, then gives up with an error that names the order.

title: retry_charge
